priorityConclusion: The inspected records do not support calling the core gameplay loop absent: combat, gathering, crafting, evolution, and save/reopen paths exist with scoped evidence. The clearest local gate is reliable wardrobe end-to-end proof, followed by status reconciliation against the build actually under review. An unintegrated gathering-progress projection is a scope-dependent local UI item, not missing gathering mechanics. Paid commerce and voice are true gaps whose next steps depend on Human/platform decisions rather than autonomous local product implementation.
